_about: The 20 target keywords for the SEO loop (approved by Jack 2026-10-19). Each one has exactly one owner page. scripts/seo-loop/opportunities.mjs reports where each target ranks and which page Google shows for it; a target ranked by the wrong page is an opportunity. A GSC query matches a target when it contains every word in `must` (lowercase, plurals folded). `page: null` means the owner page does not exist yet.
